newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 19.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.84 (+0.32)

Malaysia's state-run oil company Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) said late on Monday it is prepared to take over as operator of Vietnam's Dai Hung oil field from BHP. Also late on Monday, BHP said that its BHP Petroleum unit had been awarded four oil exploration permits in the zone of co-operation region of the Timor Sea between Australia and Indonesia.
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.84 (+0.32)

COMEX copper ended at a five month high ahead of Tuesday's LME inventory report as the market appeared to shrug off any lingering belief in the existence of huge, off-exchange stocks, traders and analysts said.December COMEX copper settled 4.20 cents firmer at 105.65 cents per pound, traded 105.90 to 100.80 cents, building on a 5.60-cent gain Friday.

Boral Ltd said on Monday it would look at rationalisation either through its own business or through the sharing of joint production facilities with its competitors. It also said on Monday it had started the 1996/97 year poorly due to continued weakness in the Australian housing market, but it was still coy about the results for the full year.
Qantas Airways Ltd would increase its domestic passenger fares by around 2.5 percent from Wednesday, The Australian newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Former ANI Ltd director Ross Palmer confirmed late on Monday that his company Tube Securities Ltd had sold 40 million of its shares in ANI.
Winemaker Australian Vintage Ltd said it would hold a one for two renounceable rights issue of 12.303 million shares at A$2.04 per share to raise A$25.10 million.
